title: Anthropic begins government-ID and biometric verification for Fable 5 access
summary: An updated Anthropic privacy policy, tied to the export-control redeployment, took effect allowing collection of government ID and facial data to verify some users' identity for Fable 5.
reason: Identity/biometric gating of AI access normalises KYC-style monitoring; modest scale, secondary sourcing.

title: NYC schools freeze tech purchases amid AI policy backlash
summary: New York City's schools chancellor paused education-technology purchases until a delayed AI policy is finalised, after public backlash; earlier guidance required bias reviews for all AI tools.
reason: Institutional pullback from AI in largest US school system.
